en.headline: Hong Kong Museum Festival 2026 carnival ends today at Cultural Centre
en.dek: The free two-day opening event at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre piazza featured pixelated old Hong Kong installations including a giant egg tart and a traditional medicine shop.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department’s Hong Kong Museum Festival 2026 runs through 30 November under the theme “Hong Kong Stories”. Its opening carnival, held at the open-air piazza of the Hong Kong Cultural Centre on 31 October and 1 November, ends today.

The free event, open from 11am to 6pm, included three themed installations blending old Hong Kong elements with pixelated design: a grid tea stall, a giant pixel egg tart for public collage, a traditional Chinese medicine shop where visitors could try preparing medicine, and a coin-toss booth recalling old amusement arcades.

Free workshops covered mahjong colouring, herbal tea keychains and pawnshop sign painting. Visitors could also join a leopard-cat dance performance and solar observation. The wider festival programme continues across 17 LCSD museums and partner venues for the rest of the month.

zh.headline: 香港博物館節2026開幕嘉年華今日結束 文化中心露天廣場
zh.dek: 一連兩日免費活動以「拼貼今昔，香港故事」為主題，設有格仔茶檔、巨型像素蛋泒及傳統中藥舖等裝置。
body: 康樂及文化事務署主辦的「香港博物館節2026」由10月31日起至11月30日舉行，主題為「香港故事」。開幕節目「繽Fun博物館嘉年華」於香港文化中心露天廣場舉行，今日是最後一天。
活動上午11時至下午6時免費開放，現場設有三個港式主題裝置，將舊香港元素融入像素化視覺：格仔茶檔、可供市民貼貼紙的巨型像素蛋泒、讓參加者體驗執藥的「香江藥號」傳統中藥舖，以及重現舊日遊樂場捂銀幣攤位的命運盲盒。
同場有免費工作坊，包括麻雀填色、涼茶牌鎖匙扣製作及大押招牌彩繪。市民亦可參與舞豺豹表演及太陽觀測。博物館節主體節目將繼續在康文署轄下17間博物館及合作場地舉行。
